title: Launch Day
goal: Load the ship correctly and lift off.

launch.liftoff.title: LIFTOFF!
launch.liftoff.text: The engines roar, the tower falls away and the ship climbs smoothly into the sky. Everything is working.

launch.damaged.title: LIFTOFF... BARELY
launch.damaged.text: You reach orbit, but the ship took a beating on the way up. The hull will need careful watching.

launch.scrubbed.title: LAUNCH SCRUBBED
launch.scrubbed.text: You called a no-go and the countdown stopped. Safe, but the crew has to start the day all over again.
launch.scrubbed.lesson: Scrubbing a launch is never a failure. Rockets get delayed all the time to stay safe. Just use the time to fix real problems.

launch.abort.title: ABORT! CREW SAFE
launch.abort.text: The abort tower yanked the capsule away from the failing rocket. The crew is fine, but the rocket is lost.
launch.abort.lesson: A skipped leak test can force an abort. Check the plumbing on the ground, not in the sky.

launch.explosion.title: VEHICLE LOST
launch.explosion.text: The leaking fuel line let go and the rocket was destroyed in a fireball. The crew had to start over.
launch.explosion.lesson: Leak checks exist for a reason. A tiny leak on the ground can become a huge problem at liftoff.
